series_key: mvc design pattern and its application
mechanism: Refactor WPR into Model/View/Controller with CInputManager, IInputBase/IOutputBase interfaces, and chart-button view switching—software structure demo with no market sensing constructed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: WPR demo indicator; no live sensing instrument locked
why_new_for_mis: After full read: MVC scaffolding and UI chrome only; no regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensing idea.
quote: The indicator will have no practical value and it should not be used in real trading.

idea_name: Defensive intraday microstructure foundation (safe math + validated history)
mechanism: MicroStructure_Foundation.mqh wraps SafeDivide/SafeLog/SafeSqrt/SafeExp/SafeTanh with NaN/Inf and overflow gates; ValidateSymbolV2 rejects anomalous spreads; SafeCopyClose rejects non-positive closes and caps sample size so downstream microstructure metrics cannot emit silent numerical failures.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 around New York open (primary target); any symbol via SafeCopyClose
why_new_for_mis: Turns numerical validity itself into a sensing precondition—MIS can treat failed safe-math/validation as a data-quality/regime-edge sensor before trusting vol or flow metrics.
quote: Its goal is practical and specific: provide a defensive MQL5 foundation that guarantees intraday measurements do not emit silent numerical failures.

idea_name: RobustFractalAnalysis container: Hurst, noise, vol persistence, seasonality
mechanism: Shared RobustFractalAnalysis struct carries confidence-weighted Hurst, Higuchi fractal dimension, GPH arfima_d, multifractal_width, volatility_persistence=2*|H-0.5|, microstructure_noise from range/body/close-open, and seasonality_strength (edge vs midday variance), plus computation_status failure codes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 NY open; series parts 2–3/10–11 consume this container
why_new_for_mis: Packages long-memory, noise, and intraday seasonality into one status-aware regime fingerprint MIS can blend by confidence rather than a single scalar.
quote: volatility_persistence; // Normalised persistence: 2 * |H - 0.5| ... microstructure_noise; // Enhanced noise estimate from range, body, and close-open ... seasonality_strength; // Intraday seasonality ratio (edge vs midday variance)

mechanism: OrderFlowSignal encodes volume-weighted directional imbalance (−1..+1), short-vs-long flow differential (momentum), current abs flow vs recent peak (exhaustion), large-bar signed volume ratio (smart_money), plus convergence/confidence and numeric direction for arithmetic pipelines.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1; used by Parts 5–6 order-flow articles in the series
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a multi-axis liquidity/pressure sensor (not just signed volume) with explicit exhaustion and smart-money sub-channels.
quote: Strength is the directional imbalance; momentum is its rate of change; exhaustion captures fading flow; and smart_money reflects the impact of high-volume bars.

idea_name: TimeAwareSignal: session regime × spread liquidity sizing
mechanism: TimeAwareSignal embeds OrderFlowSignal and layers time_regime_multiplier (e.g. 1.5 NY open / 0.5 off-peak), session_liquidity_factor from spread (0.3–1.2), pre_event_boost, and time_adjusted_confidence to drive max_position_size and stop_loss_multiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1; NY open emphasized; Part 7 synthesis
why_new_for_mis: Couples liquidity (spread) and clock-regime into one confidence/size sensor so MIS can scale exposure by session microstructure, not only by directional flow.
quote: session_liquidity_factor;   // Spread-based liquidity scaling (0.3–1.2) ... time_regime_multiplier;     // Session weight: 1.5 at NY open, 0.5 off-peak

idea_name: 10% trimmed robust_mean_var with skew and excess kurtosis
mechanism: robust_mean_var sorts the sample, symmetrically trims 10% extremes, then computes mean/variance plus skewness and excess kurtosis on the trimmed core (fallback to two-pass mean_var if too small)—designed so NY-open fat tails do not dominate the typical-behavior estimate.
data_needed: return or price array length n≥4
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NQ M1 at NY open; kurtosis feeds Part 4 volatility analysis
why_new_for_mis: Fat-tail-aware vol/higher-moment sensor that separates extreme-event mass from central volatility—useful for MIS regime and vol quality checks on intraday futures.
quote: On NQ M1 data at the NY open, those extreme values are real—they are not measurement errors—but they should not dominate a statistical estimate intended to characterize typical behavior.

idea_name: Spread>10000-point feed sanity as liquidity/quality gate
mechanism: ValidateSymbolV2 retries bid/ask/point up to three times; if (ask−bid)/point ≥ 10000 it rejects the symbol as non-tradable or feed-broken—used before any CopyClose-based microstructure calc.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol; illustrated for NQ intraday toolkit
why_new_for_mis: Explicit spread-based liquidity/feed-quality sensor that can veto downstream MIS metrics when the book is pathological.
quote: The spread check of less than 10,000 points is a sanity filter—a spread wider than this indicates either a data feed problem or a symbol that is not tradable.

idea_name: Bayesian HPO ADXR/DI-separation regime gate for DI crossovers
mechanism: Optuna TPE searches adxr_threshold∈[15,50], di_period∈[7,28], min_di_separation∈[0,15] to maximize triple-barrier precision on a time-ordered validation slice; gate admits only DI crossovers coherent with a directional regime before any secondary model runs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; Jan 2018–Dec 2024 (IS→2021, OOS 2022–2024); also tick-3000 bars provided
why_new_for_mis: Replaces Wilder’s fixed ADXR≥25 with a data-driven trending-vs-ranging gate—MIS can reuse the three-parameter regime screen independent of the trade system.
quote: The gate asks a coarse question: is the market in a directional state where a trend-following signal is structurally coherent?

idea_name: ADX bar-context features: slope, cross persistence, DI dominance age
mechanism: At each gated crossover compute adx_slope_5, di_separation/di_separation_delta, bars_since_last_cross (choppy-regime risk), dominant_di_duration (age of exiting trend), atr_ratio, and session_sin/cos; Random Forest meta-labeler uses these to predict triple-barrier success.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; feature MDI leads: adx_slope_5, atr_ratio, di_separation
why_new_for_mis: Senses regime *change quality* at the DI flip—acceleration, chop frequency, and prior-dominance age—beyond a static ADX level.
quote: bars_since_last_cross — bars elapsed since the previous DI crossover, encoding choppy-market risk (frequent crossovers indicate a ranging regime); dominant_di_duration — how many consecutive bars the now-reversing DI was dominant

idea_name: atr_ratio at DI cross as bar-level volatility context
mechanism: Feature atr_ratio = bar true range / ATR(14) at the crossover; secondary RF ranks it second in MDI (0.14), capturing whether the regime-shift bar was an outlier active event vs a quiet whipsaw.
why_new_for_mis: Localizes volatility sensing to the exact regime-change bar rather than a global vol regime—useful for MIS change-event quality scoring.
quote: the ATR ratio captures whether the crossover bar itself was an outlier event.

idea_name: Secondary RF meta-label + confidence bet-sizing on ADX signals
mechanism: After the HPO gate, Random Forest predicts P(profitable|11 ADX features); signals below confidence threshold are suppressed; survivors sized via afml.bet_sizing from classifier probability (three-track WF on EURUSD H1).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; Track3: 29 signals, max DD −44 pips vs −965 plain
why_new_for_mis: Sequence of gate→classifier→size is a deployable neural/secondary sensor of trend-signal viability MIS can attach to any primary side model.
quote: The secondary model predicts bet: whether the primary model's current signal is likely to be profitable, given context the primary model does not observe.

idea_name: Bollinger bandwidth regime (BBB / bb_bw_regime) as mean-reversion viability
mechanism: BBB=(upper−lower)/middle; bb_bw_regime=1 when BBB exceeds train-only 75th percentile; with bb_bw_mom (3-bar pct change) and is_widening_bb, secondary GBM learns when band touches are breakouts not reversions.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 deployment path (EURUSD_time_H1_signals.csv); BB window=20
why_new_for_mis: Self-diagnostic envelope-width regime sensor that tells MIS when mean-reversion assumptions are structurally false.
quote: High BBB indicates a volatile, potentially trending environment; low BBB indicates a quiet ranging market where mean reversion is more plausible.

idea_name: Joint ADX + bandwidth to separate trend vs range vol-spike
mechanism: Secondary features include BBB/bb_bw_regime plus ADX_14/DMP/DMN; MDI shows bandwidth features dominate but ADX still matters—together distinguish high-ADX expanding-band trends from high-bandwidth/low-ADX volatility spikes in ranges (different MR trade quality).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 meta-label pipeline; synthetic regime panels for illustration
why_new_for_mis: Orthogonalizes directional momentum vs volatility expansion—MIS can avoid conflating ‘wide bands’ with ‘trending’ when sizing or filtering mean-reversion bets.
quote: ADX captures directional momentum; bandwidth captures volatility expansion. Neither is sufficient alone; together they allow the secondary model to distinguish a genuinely trending market (high ADX, expanding bandwidth) from a volatility spike in a ranging market (high bandwidth, low ADX).

mechanism: BBP=(close−lower)/(upper−lower) flags penetrations (<0 or >1); features shifted one bar before secondary GBM outputs P(take); calibrated probs map through bet_size_probability to signed size with concurrency correction.
data_needed: explicit mid/sd bands (not portable BB helpers)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 two-EA bus; threshold default meta_prob≥0.55
why_new_for_mis: Turns band-touch extremity and timing into a change/quality sensor with leak-safe lag—MIS can score envelope events without lookahead.
quote: a value below 0 means price has penetrated the lower band; a value above 1 means price has penetrated the upper band.
